# SVE and SVE2 cases for tests/a64_sve.rs, generated by gen_sve.py from QEMU 11.1
# (qemu-system-aarch64 -M virt -cpu max,sve-max-vq=N -accel tcg) at EL1.
#
# A line "vq N" starts the cases for a vector length of N quadwords. Each case is
# the instruction word, then what it changed from the initial state of a64_sve.rs:
# zN, pN and ffr as one hex number (element 0 lowest), xN, nzcv (the four flag
# bits), esr (ESR_EL1 if the instruction raised an exception) and mOFF, the 64-bit
# little endian word at byte offset OFF from X8, fpsr (FPSR if not zero). Then the
# assembly, after "{A} " for a case run with SCTLR_EL1.A set, X16 = X8 + 8 and
# X17 = X8 + 9, or "{P1} " for an SVE2p1 instruction.
vq 1
